contexts.text: The breast with the most ancients signified charity, because the heart and lungs are there. AC 247. AC 259. HH 97.
Under Chest, see this reference, and at AC 4403.
Heat... descending towards the middle region of the breast... A more interior heat beginning from the breast... A still more interior heat from the loins upwards towards the breast...
By the breast is signified good and truth, good because the heart is in it, and truth because the lungs are.
By the breast and the things of the breast are represented rational things and what belongs to rational things.
The breast and arms of the statue = spiritual or rational things, which are silver.
(The breast of the infants adorned with flowers.)
The breast and arms of silver = the second state of the Church, which was spiritual, because one of charity towards the neighbour. AC 10030:3.
The breast, or heart and lungs, = Divine celestial and spiritual love.
(Cause pain in the periosteum of the breast.)
In the idea of Spirits the planet Mars appears... in the plane of the breast...
Under Girdle, see this reference.
The breast even to the loins corresponds to the middle or second Heaven, where there is spiritual good.
The breast, in general, = spiritual good, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour. AC 10075:2.
Thou shalt take the breast () = the Divine Spiritual in the Heavens. Breast = the good of charity, and in the supreme sense, the Divine Spiritual. Explained, Illustrated.

The reason the breast was given to Moses for a portion, and the shoulder to Aaron () was that the breast = Divine truth in the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, and the shoulder Divine good in the Celestial Kingdom. AC 10091.
The sides and breast with man = the interiors; for all the representatives in nature relate to the human form, and have a signification according to that relation.
The middle Heaven forms the breast even to the loins and knees.
They who are in the breast of the Grand Man are in the good of charity and of faith, and they also inflow into man's breast, and correspond to it.

(As the Church where the Word is read and the Lord is known is as the heart and lungs in the Grand Man of the Church on earth) Christians... constitute the breast of that Man; for they are in the midst of all...
The breast defined.
The delight of domineering... was felt as an agreeable and pleasurable sensation in the swelling breast.
Like rottenness in the breast...
The Divine Spiritual is meant by His eyes, and by the breast which was girt with a golden girdle. ().
(The Angels) are in delight of the whole breast from peace of soul... TCR 622.
Under Love of the Sex, see this reference.
Love... conjoins their minds, and thence enters their breasts...
The loves of a man for a man and of a woman for a woman do not enter deeply into the breast, but stand outside...
Under Bless, see this reference.
Marriage love, which opens their breasts...
(Man's sphere) is dense on the breast...
Under Marriage Love, see these references. CL 179:end.

The bosom is the forum of assembly and as a king's court... For all things which are determined into the body from the soul and mind inflow first into the breast... and because there is the dominion over all things of the body, for the heart and lungs are there, and the heart reigns everywhere by means of the blood, and the lungs by means of the breathing.
The inmost friendship (between married partners) is felt in the breast. CL 183:7. CL 214.
(The Divine influx passes from these) through the breast into the genital region. CL 183:6.

By a man's breast is signified that essential and proprium which is distinguished from a woman's breast, and is wisdom; for truth supports wisdom as a rib supports the breast. The reason these things are signified is that the breast is that in which all things of man are as in their centre.
Under Wife, see these references. CL 293:3. CL 293:5. CL 294:2. CL 294:4.
(The breast of a devil swollen into a rhomb.)
We the created teachers of the Church, when we preached, felt the holy operation of that mission in our breasts...
If (this infernal delight) be received by the head in the forehead, and by the body in the breast, the man is enslaved to Hell.
I long laboured in the breast through the influx from the Christian world...
The quality of all was felt through influx into the breast...

The paps = spiritual love, and the breast the very good thereof... The reason the breast = the good of spiritual love, is from correspondence with Heaven... The middle or second Heaven corresponds to the breast...
Under Bosom, see this reference.
